question: Round-003 C stays: full width, no heading, bar at the bottom. You said "tag select is not easy one". Which tag picker is easiest? Try a few tags in each.

variants.label: Two-row bar, tags always shown
variants.changes: "Tag select is not easy": all 10 tags always shown as same-size toggles in a second bar row. One click per tag, no menu. Costs one row of frame height.

variants.label: One row, tags on demand
variants.changes: "Tag select is not easy": one row like round-003 C. "+ tags" opens all 10 toggles in a row inside the bar, no overlay. Picked tags show as chips, 2 then +n. The row closes after submit.

variants.label: One row, tags inline
variants.changes: "Tag select is not easy": all 10 tags as compact toggles in the one row, between pick and a narrower reason. On a narrow screen reason and submit wrap to a second row.
